text: Because industry practices and informal rules already protect their relationships and investments, qualified investors may neither desire nor require extended investor protection rules to optimize hedge fund valuation.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability

abstract: Given their role in the industry, and the industry practices and informal rules that protect their relationships and investments, qualified investors may not desire nor require extended investor protection rules to optimize valuation of hedge funds.
